# ctables/assign

> Assignment: to a variable, or through an address (fields, elements, `*p`).

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/assign.pkg) · translates [std/assign](../std/assign.md)

  The value is evaluated before the address, as in bintables. Targets of
  size 1 (`u8`) store one byte.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when target is var`

```nasm
{target.addr} =
{value}
;
```

### `emit when target size 1`

```nasm
{ W {L.v} =
{value}
; B *{L.p} = (B *)(
{target!addr}
); *{L.p} = (B){L.v}; }
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{ W {L.v} =
{value}
; W *{L.p} = (W *)(
{target!addr}
); *{L.p} = {L.v}; }
```
